facts.fact_text: Some of the applications raise an issue concerning the right to freedom of peaceful assembly in connection with the applicants' protests against the landfill site near the town of Klin, Moscow Region.
In March 2018 the applicants started organising protests against the landfill site at Aleksinskiy Quarry.
All the applicants except Ms Kotova (application no. 106/19) were charged with various administrative offences in connection with their protests against the landfill site.
In November 2017 Mr Kotov submitted three notices of a public event (meeting) to the Klin municipal administration.
In May 2018 Mr Kotov submitted one notice of an environmental protest car rally to the Klin municipal administration.
All the applicants except Ms Kotova (application no. 106/19) were charged with various administrative offences in connection with their protests against the landfill site.
The details concerning the charges against the applicants, their arrest and the administrative sanctions imposed on them in connection with their protests are outlined in Appendix I of the judgment.
Neither of Mr Kotov's applications to the Klin municipal administration for a public event or environmental protest car rally was approved.

Federal Law no. 7-FZ of 10 January 2002 regulates the protection of the environment in Russia, covering types of polluting entities, the requirement of industrial self-monitoring, the right to information, the right to protest, the right to compensation, and the right to bring complaints.
All the applicants except Ms Kotova (application no. 106/19) were charged with various administrative offences in connection with their protests against the landfill site.
The details concerning the charges against the applicants, their arrest and the administrative sanctions imposed on them in connection with their protests are outlined in Appendix I of the judgment.
Neither of Mr Kotov's applications to the Klin municipal administration for a public event or environmental protest car rally was approved.
Mr Kotov brought a complaint against the Klin municipal authorities before the courts in connection with the non-approval of his applications for public events.
The details of the proceedings brought by Mr Kotov against the Klin municipal authorities are outlined in Appendix I (application no. 56764/18) of the judgment.
